description: Source code for the 'base_report_creator' module in an OpenERP/Odoo environment, defining classes for report creation, fields, and filters, including methods for SQL query generation, view rendering, and data export.

classes.name: report_creator
classes.description: Main class for managing report creation, including SQL query generation, view rendering, data export, and validation.

classes.name: report_creator_field
classes.description: Defines fields to be displayed in reports, including grouping and visualization options.

classes.name: report_creator_filter
classes.description: Defines filters for reports, including filter expressions and logical conditions.

methods.name: export_data
methods.description: Exports specified fields from report data as a list of lists.

methods.name: fields_get
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions for a report, considering context and report configuration.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Generates XML view architecture for different report views (form, graph, calendar).

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads report data, executes SQL queries, and formats results, including related record names.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches reports based on criteria, constructing SQL queries with filters.

methods.name: _path_get
methods.description: Constructs SQL FROM and JOIN clauses based on model relationships.

methods.name: _id_get
methods.description: Returns SQL expression for the record ID, typically a minimum ID.

methods.name: _sql_query_get
methods.description: Builds SQL SELECT statements for reports, including grouping, filtering, and limits.

methods.name: _function_field
methods.description: Validates that report fields are stored and can be used in reports.

methods.name: _aggregation_error
methods.description: Checks if aggregate functions are applied only to appropriate field types.

methods.name: _calander_view_error
methods.description: Validates calendar view configurations for required fields.

methods.name: _path_get
methods.description: Constructs SQL JOIN clauses based on model relationships.
